title: Inventory Manager: Smart Storage
description: A simple and powerful Minecraft inventory and chest management mod.
body:
Inventory Manager

Inventory Manager is a Minecraft mod designed to make chest, inventory, and storage management much simpler, faster, and more enjoyable.

The mod adds a complete in-game interface to help you organize your chests, transfer items, sort your inventory, and manage your storage systems more easily. It is especially useful in survival worlds when you start having many chests, many resources, and want to save time instead of sorting everything manually.

Main Features
Rename and register chests
Automatically detect registered chests around the player
Display an item directly on a chest in the world
Choose the display side of the item on the chest
Automatic deposit system
Search bar inside chests
Transfer buttons between the chest and the inventory
Automatic inventory sorting
Automatic chest sorting
Favorites system to keep important items organized
Simple, clean interface integrated into the Minecraft style
Automatic Deposit

The automatic deposit system allows you to link specific items to a specific chest. Once configured, the mod can automatically deposit selected items into the correct chest, making it much easier to store resources without having to move everything manually.

Item Display on Chests

Inventory Manager also allows you to display an item directly on a chest in the world. This is useful for quickly identifying what a chest contains without needing to open it. You can also choose the item’s display position on the chest, such as front, back, left, right, or positions adapted for double chests.

Favorites

The favorites system allows you to keep important items in specific slots, such as tools, weapons, or useful items. This helps keep your inventory clean and organized while playing.

Why Use Inventory Manager?

Inventory Manager is made for players who want to spend less time sorting chests and more time playing. Whether you are building a survival base, a storage room, or playing a modded adventure, this mod makes item management much more comfortable.

Requirements
Minecraft 26.1.2
Fabric Loader
Fabric API
Version

First public release of the mod.
